definitions.gloss: out of ~; ~ has run out; ~ has expired
definitions.explanation: Attached to a noun to say that a supply or a period has run out: {電池切|でんちぎ}れ "dead battery," {期限切|きげんぎ}れ "expired." The き of {切|き}れ is voiced to ぎ.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{電池切|でんちぎ}れ→電池切れ：07688_denchigire⟧だ。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{在庫切|ざいこぎ}れ→在庫切れ：08305_zaikogire⟧です。
examples.english: That item is out of stock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}→牛乳：00777_gyuunyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{期限切|きげんぎ}れ→期限切れ：15893_kigengire⟧になっていた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{捨|す}てた→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧。
examples.english: The milk in the fridge had passed its date, so I threw it away.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{期限切|きげんぎ}れ→期限切れ：15893_kigengire⟧: expired, past the deadline
- ⟦{電池切|でんちぎ}れ→電池切れ：07688_denchigire⟧: dead battery
- ⟦{在庫切|ざいこぎ}れ→在庫切れ：08305_zaikogire⟧, ⟦{品切|しなぎ}れ→品切れ：09557_shinagire⟧: out of stock
- ⟦{時間切|じかんぎ}れ→時間切れ：30253_jikangire⟧: time is up
- ⟦{息切|いきぎ}れ→息切れ：06300_ikigire⟧: shortness of breath

USAGE:
- The compounds are nouns, used with だ or ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (⟦{期限切|きげんぎ}れ→期限切れ：15893_kigengire⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧, to expire). The verb behind them is {切|き}れる (to run out).

WATCH OUT:
- {売|う}り{切|き}れ and ⟦{品切|しなぎ}れ→品切れ：09557_shinagire⟧ look alike: {売|う}り{切|き}れ means sold out (the item sold well), ⟦{品切|しなぎ}れ→品切れ：09557_shinagire⟧ simply out of stock.
